name: IoT
description: Multi-tenant MQTT device registry (Organization, Device, memberships) with strict JSON envelope handling, Wagtail admin dashboards, and OTA firmware delivery (signed HTTPS download + MQTT ota_command.v1 / ota_status.v1). Integrates with the project mqtt bridge (apps.mqtt) for publish/subscribe.
author: RhamaaCMS

notes.module_path: Python package is apps.IoT (capital IoT) — use exactly that in INSTALLED_APPS and imports.
notes.re_development: Start from apps/IoT/docs/protocol.md (envelope + OTA), constants.py (ALLOWED_SCHEMAS, OTA_*), then services.py (ingress) and ota_services.py (jobs + downlink). Wagtail UI is under /admin/iot/; public OTA download is registered on the project root, not in this app’s urls.py.

IOT_OTA_PUBLIC_BASE.note: Optional. Public origin for OTA download URLs in MQTT (no trailing slash), e.g. https://api.example.com. If unset, ota_services.get_ota_public_base_url() uses django.contrib.sites Site, else DEBUG http://127.0.0.1:8000. Devices must reach this host over HTTPS in production.

urls.name: Public index + future public pages
urls.note: Mounted in project solar_monitoring_apps/urls.py. Currently a small index; device admin lives in Wagtail.
Registered by wagtail_hooks.py (register_admin_urls) — do NOT duplicate in project urls.py. Namespaced as iot: (e.g. iot:dashboard, iot:panel_ota).

urls.name: iot_ota_firmware_download
urls.note: PROJECT-LEVEL only: add to solar_monitoring_apps/urls.py before Wagtail catch-all. Signed GET ?t= for device firmware download; not behind Wagtail auth.

hooks.description: Submenu 'IoT' (order=240) with Ringkasan, Organisasi, Pengguna & organisasi, Perangkat, OTA.

snippets: Organization — tenant; slug must match MQTT envelope org
FirmwarePackage — binary upload, sha256, product+version unique
DeviceOTAJob — one OTA attempt; status + job_id; publish from panel_ota

mqtt.uplink: Handler calls apps.IoT.services.process_incoming_mqtt_message from the mqtt app when messages arrive (configure subscription to iot/v1/# or stricter).

ota.constants: apps/IoT/constants.py — OTA_CHANNEL, OTA_SCHEMA_COMMAND, OTA_SCHEMA_STATUS, OTA_DOWNLOAD_SALT, OTA_MAX_FIRMWARE_BYTES
ota.flow: Set Device.firmware_product to match FirmwarePackage.product. Create FirmwarePackage (snippet) → panel_ota: create DeviceOTAJob (supersedes other in-flight jobs for device) → Terbitkan (pending) → device GET signed URL → device reports ota_status.v1. Republish available for sent jobs if downlink missed. MQTT publish errors keep job pending.

files.models.py: Organization, OrganizationMembership, Device, FirmwarePackage, DeviceOTAJob; register_snippet on all tenant/firmware types.
files.services.py: parse_iot_uplink_topic, validate_envelope, process_incoming_mqtt_message; dispatches ota_status.v1 to ota_services.apply_ota_status_uplink.
files.admin_views.py: Wagtail panels: dashboard, organizations, memberships, devices, OTA (create job + publish).
files.admin_snippet_urls.py: Reverse Wagtail snippet list/add/edit for templates.
files.docs/protocol.md: Human-readable contract for teams and firmware (envelope, telemetry, OTA downlink/uplink).
files.migrations/: Run: python manage.py makemigrations iot && migrate (app label is lowercase 'iot').

optional_apps: channels (if WebSocket MQTT log UI is used in admin)
dependencies.note: MQTT client packages come from apps/mqtt (e.g. aiomqtt in project requirements). IoT app uses asgiref.async_to_sync to publish from sync code.

variables.description: Public base URL for OTA links (see django.settings IOT_OTA_PUBLIC_BASE).
Project-level MQTT; see base.py and apps/mqtt.

messages: Ensure 'apps.IoT' and 'apps.mqtt' are in INSTALLED_APPS; run migrations for app label 'iot' (e.g. python manage.py migrate iot).
If OTA is used, register path('ota/firmware/', ota_public_download) in the project urlconf and set IOT_OTA_PUBLIC_BASE in .env in production if Site domain ≠ device-reachable host.

Point MQTT consumer at process_incoming_mqtt_message; subscribe to cover iot/v1/{org}/{device_id}/up/# and downlink publisher must use the same topic prefix (iot/v1) as constants.IOT_MQTT_TOPIC_PREFIX.
Extend: add schemas to ALLOWED_SCHEMAS; document in protocol.md; keep envelope validation in services in sync.
